\section{\texttt{DeterministicQueryRewriter}}
\label{class:feedback_intelligence_agent.memory.DeterministicQueryRewriter}\index{Classes!DeterministicQueryRewriter}

Local, deterministic follow-up rewriter with two transparent rules.
\apifield{Attributes}
\begin{arglist}
  \item[\texttt{short\_\allowbreak{}question\_\allowbreak{}tokens}] \texttt{int}, default \texttt{4}
\end{arglist}
\apifield{Details}1. **Pronoun resolution**: standalone pronouns (\texttt{it}, \texttt{they}, \texttt{them}, trailing \texttt{this}/\texttt{that}/...) are replaced with the salient entities of the previous user message. 2. **Ellipsis expansion**: elliptical openers ("What about X?", "And X?") and very short questions get the previous turn's missing entities appended ("... regarding enterprise onboarding").

Standalone questions are returned unchanged, so single-turn behaviour is never affected. No model call is involved.
\apifield{Source}\texttt{src/\allowbreak{}feedback\_\allowbreak{}intelligence\_\allowbreak{}agent/\allowbreak{}memory.\allowbreak{}py:257}~(\href{https://github.com/DiogoRibeiro7/feedback-intelligence-agent/blob/249253f371fc682b42be23d75ec314d58837767d/src/feedback_intelligence_agent/memory.py#L257}{online}), class, module \cref{module:feedback_intelligence_agent.memory}
